description: Table of contents for one Taiwan law: its chapter/section headings and the article number of every provision, in order, paged. Use to browse a law's structure before reading a specific article with tw_law_article, or to enumerate every article number a long law has. Returns has_more and next_offset when the law has more entries than the page size.

name.description: Chinese or English law title, used when pcode is not known.

pcode.description: The law's pcode (from tw_law_search or tw_law_info).
